slides.alt: A Prenzlauer Berg street with autumn trees and cobblestones. Text: We took a bike trip on an autumn afternoon and our daughter fell asleep on the bike.
A sidewalk with yellow leaves and parked bikes under bare trees. Text: Now we look to the left and right and ask ourselves: how do we get our coffee without waking her up?
A hand holding a red Coffee Circle paper cup in front of coffee shop shelves. Text: We finally made it in the queue, while she still slept.
Three paper coffee cups held by adult and child hands at a cafe table. Text: And she did not cry one bit when she woke up. She just sipped on her babyccino.
